image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a black bird feeder. The bird displays characteristic breeding male plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and mottled brown/black/white upperparts. The beak is conical and sharp. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.
